subscription.title: ClipTap Pro
subscription.manage_description: You can manage your subscription in the store
subscription.feature_unlimited_items_desc: Register unlimited snippets, shortcuts and values
subscription.keyboard_guide_full_access_note: To also count insertions made from the keyboard, turn on "Allow Full Access" on the same screen. The keyboard works without it.
subscription.cancel_steps_ios:
1. Open iOS Settings app
2. Tap your Apple ID at the top
3. Tap "Subscriptions"
4. Select ClipTap Pro
5. Tap "Cancel Subscription"
subscription.cancel_steps_android:
1. Open Google Play Store app
2. Tap your profile icon in the top right
3. Tap "Payments & subscriptions" → "Subscriptions"
4. Select ClipTap Pro
5. Tap "Cancel subscription"

export_import.title: Backup & Restore
export_import.export_description: Save all data to a single file
export_import.import_description: Replace all current data with a backup file
export_import.version_notice: If the app versions differ between backup and restore, the file may not load correctly. Please update the app to the latest version on both devices.
export_import.step1: Back up on the source device and set a password
export_import.step2: Share the backup file to the target device (AirDrop, email, etc.)
export_import.step3: Restore on the target device with the same password (all data on that device will be replaced)
export_import.export_password_hint: Set a password used to verify this file when restoring (the content is not encrypted)
export_import.import_password_hint: Enter the password you set when backing up
